name: Whole Home Remodeling
summary: Complete home remodeling with coordinated planning, selective demolition, layout changes, kitchens, bathrooms, flooring, drywall, painting, carpentry, doors, lighting, plumbing fixtures and finish work.
features: Doors, trim, cabinets and finish carpentry

faqs.question: What is included in a whole home remodel?
faqs.answer: The scope may include layout changes, kitchens, bathrooms, flooring, drywall, texture, painting, doors, trim, cabinets, lighting, plumbing fixtures and other coordinated improvements selected for the property.

faqs.question: Can a whole home remodel be completed in phases?
faqs.answer: Yes. Larger renovations can be divided into logical phases based on budget, material availability, access to the home and the order required for inspections and trade work.

faqs.question: Can homeowners remain in the property during construction?
faqs.answer: It depends on the extent of demolition, utility interruptions, dust control and how many rooms are affected. Some phased projects allow partial occupancy, while extensive renovations may require temporary arrangements.

faqs.question: How are multiple trades coordinated during a full renovation?
faqs.answer: The project is sequenced so demolition, framing, rough plumbing and electrical, inspections, drywall, cabinets, flooring, painting and finish work occur in the proper order.
